sections.title: Acknowledgment
sections.html:
I acknowledge that I have received a copy of the MH Construction, Inc. Employee Handbook, Revision 4.0, and that I have read and understand its contents. I understand that this handbook is not a contract of employment, and that MH Construction, Inc. reserves the right to modify, revoke, suspend, terminate, or change any or all plans, policies, or procedures in whole or in part, at any time, with or without notice.

I understand that my employment is at-will and may be terminated by either party at any time, with or without cause or notice. I agree to comply with all policies and procedures contained in this handbook.
